integrity: Scientific result presented with an explicit proof and reproducer, and same-model review only; no independent audit, formal proof, or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to compact intrinsically flat tori, independent Haar vertices, and almost-sure shortest geodesics.
Uniform local limit has constants for a fixed lattice and dimension, not degenerating lattice families.
Three-vertex flat-torus null-homotopy cases, classical B-spline/Eulerian identities, and one-dimensional Gaussian spline asymptotics are explicitly known prior art.
No general lattice extremum, full metric reconstruction, or independent priority assessment is claimed.
title: Voronoi-convolution homotopy law for random shortest-geodesic polygons on flat tori
